title: improve gardening
description: improves hoes, composters and allows you to gain experience from the harvest!
body:
## Description: **improves hoes, composters and allows you to gain experience from the harvest.
_Сonfiguration support, you are free to fully customize the plugin_!** ## New features: 1. **new mechanics to the hoe** - when you right-click on it, it will collect and automatically plant plants within a 3-by-3 block radius around the player. _Fortune also applies to the collected plants!_

2. **improves the composter** - removes animation before getting the bone meal, and _also increases the amount of bone meal that falls out._

3. **Gain experience by picking plants with a hoe!**
## Configuration: enable-plugin: true - _completely disables the plugin when "false"_
enable-hoe-rework: true - _disables new features of the hoe_
durability-spend-chances:
100: 1
enable-composter-buff: true - _disables new features of the composter_
composter-bone-meal-drop-chances:
100: 4
50: 2
25: 1
enable-experience-from-crops: true - _disables experience from crops_
experience-drop-chances:
100: 1
20: 1
## How work chances: **using the durability calculation example:**
durability-spend-chances - calculation of the chances of spending the tool's durability for one transplanted plant, by default 1 durability with a 100% chance, you can add chances yourself. Example: durability-spend-chances:
100: 1
50: 1 always spend 1 durability, but additionally with a 50% chance to spend another 1 and in the end there will be 2. **using the example of a composter, 4 flours will always fall, but with a 50% chance of 2 more and 25% of 1 more being added.** ## Contacts: If you have any problems or questions, please contact me on Discord in private messages - "gusenok2". Good luck in your adventures!
